rust_locations.role: Builds measured note nodes and ownership clusters. LEFT/RIGHT add a same-rank constraint and then LayoutGraph::add_edge, while TOP/BOTTOM correctly use explicit minlen=1.
add_edge leaves minlen unset, allowing Graphviz's default of 1; add_edge_with_minlen can encode Java's explicit zero without introducing a spacing constant.
Shows a 35.3793-pixel gap between the inbox node and its right attached-note body after the 35-pixel SVEK nodesep.

Shows the same measured node and note widths but a 69.3793-pixel gap: one additional approximately 34-pixel separation unit propagates into the inner folder, outer cloud, canvas, nodes, edge, and note positions. These observed values diagnose the model and are not constants to copy.

claimed_invariant: Deployment attached-note placement is represented by an ordinary measured note node and a synthetic dashed link before opale absorbs the link at paint time. The link length is semantic Graphviz input: RIGHT and LEFT are horizontal length-1 links and therefore carry minlen=0, while TOP and BOTTOM are vertical length-2 links and carry minlen=1. Ownership only determines which cluster contains the measured note and target; quoted IDs and UGroup qualified-name projection do not alter the attachment edge's rank length.
causal_divergence: Rust correctly places the right attached note and its target on the same rank but calls LayoutGraph::add_edge, which leaves minlen unset and gives Graphviz the default minlen=1. Java's CommandFactoryNoteOnEntity creates LinkArg.noDisplay(1), and SvekEdge.appendLine emits minlen=0. In fresh2_quoted_identity_deep_ownership the extra Rust separation widens the nested folder and outer cloud, then shifts every downstream primitive. The metadata projection is already exact on both sides, so changing identities, labels, dimensions, margins, or cloud coordinates would be overfitting.
planned_model_change: For LEFT and RIGHT deployment attached notes, preserve the current direction and same-rank ownership constraint but emit the synthetic layout edge through add_edge_with_minlen(..., 0).
Retain explicit minlen=1 for TOP and BOTTOM, deriving both values from Java LinkArg length minus one rather than a fixture or coordinate observation.
